title: World rules and memory
intro: Rules, evidence and history over the existing encyclopedia. Simulation results never become facts automatically.
designGoal: Design world rules with mechanisms, costs, conditions, exceptions, loopholes and unknown parameters. Do not invent solver results.
empty: No rule cards yet. Start with one sentence and add conditions as needed.
editWorldEntity: Select an entry to edit its periods
chooseRule: Select a rule or create one in natural language.
name: Name
formalHint: Use solver, inputs, constraints, outputs and acceptance_rules from the existing experiment format. This stores data only; review and freeze criteria before running.
timeHint: Intervals include the start and exclude the end. Dates and exact instants are not mixed. Instants need a time zone; custom calendars use a named numeric coordinate.
publicSummary: Author releases this summary for selected writing contexts
writerHint: Raw rules, author secrets and history are not sent automatically. Select and approve the context packet in the editor.
confirmSave: I reviewed this adoption, hard rule or summary release
impactHint: Impact paths follow only author-confirmed dependencies. Associations, conditional effects and AI hypotheses stay separate.
evidenceHint: Uses this project’s reference library. Read and save an exact excerpt before linking it. References are not story Canon.
parseQueued: Original retained; parsing is queued. Refresh to view its status.
referencePurpose: Worldbuilding reference; not automatically story fact
manuscriptCitation: Cite saved manuscript in this project
manuscriptHint: Use a saved chapter path, revision and unique exact excerpt. A mismatch is rejected.
memoryHint: Queries the existing index and author records. Historical queries need story time. Missing evidence remains unknown; current state is never used to fill it.
explainMemory: Explain existing settings from selected sources; state unknowns without inventing facts.
aiExplain: Open selected sources in the existing AI designer
periodHint: Period facts are author records in this entry, distinct from committed State reconstruction. Editing time is not story time; overlapping periods report conflicts.
factsJson: Explicit period facts (JSON object; no current-field backfill)
simulationHint: Select confirmed rules and applicable entities, then inspect their mathematical mapping. Open the existing lab to freeze criteria and run. Counterfactuals and comparisons use that same lab.
acceptConditions: I reviewed applicability and exceptions for this run
confirmMapping: I reviewed variables, conditions, rule versions and unknowns
openExperiment: Save draft and open logic lab
characterMemoryHint: Reads Ledger and original receipts. Missing history is never filled from current state. First queries on large projects may be slow.
explicitCoverage: This query covers the selected entry, not every world record.
boundedCoverage: Keyword retrieval shows up to 40 entries; this is not a complete book or world review.

states.TEXT_NOT_OBJECTIVE_WORLD_FACT: Manuscript quotation, not an objective world fact
states.AUTHOR_CONFIRMED_CURRENT_EDIT_NOT_PAST_S: Current confirmed setting, not past state
